claims.object_text: encodes a core subunit of the cohesin complex that plays a pivotal role in genome organization and gene regulation
claims.quote: The X-linked SMC1A gene encodes a core subunit of the cohesin complex that plays a pivotal role in genome organization and gene regulation.
Pathogenic variants in SMC1A are often dominant-negative and cause Cornelia de Lange syndrome (CdLS) with growth retardation and typical facial features;

claims.object_text: Cornelia de Lange syndrome (CdLS) with growth retardation and typical facial features
claims.quote: cause Cornelia de Lange syndrome (CdLS) with growth retardation and typical facial features;

claims.object_text: developmental and epileptic encephalopathy (DEE) with intractable early-onset epilepsy
claims.quote: rare SMC1A variants cause a developmental and epileptic encephalopathy (DEE) with intractable early-onset epilepsy that is absent in CdLS.
SMC1A-DEE loss-of-function (LOF) variants are found exclusively in females due to presumed lethality in males.

claims.object_text: non-LOF variants in ATPase head or hinge predicted to affect cohesin assembly, mimicking LOFs
claims.quote: 7/8 non-LOFs are specifically located in the N/C-terminal ATPase head or the central hinge domain, both of which are predicted to affect cohesin assembly, thus mimicking LOFs.

claims.object_text: differential SMC1A dosage effect associated with DEE phenotypes
claims.quote: these variants strongly suggest that a differential SMC1A dosage effect of SMC1A-DEE variants is closely associated with the manifestation of DEE phenotypes.
